sections.heading: Section B: Written Questions (76 marks)
items: 1. Define the term 'isotope' and give an example. (3 marks)
2. Write the electronic configuration of calcium (atomic number 20). (3 marks)
3. Using the periodic table section in the diagram, state the group and period of fluorine. (3 marks)
4. Write a balanced equation for the reaction between sodium hydroxide and hydrochloric acid. (3 marks)
5. Explain the difference between an ionic and a covalent bond. (4 marks)
6. Calculate the number of moles in 4 g of sodium hydroxide (Na = 23, O = 16, H = 1). (3 marks)
